from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objects = []
    for color in sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(x for row in grid for x, v in enumerate(row) if v == c)):
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        top = min(r for r, c in cells)
        left = min(c for r, c in cells)
        bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
        right = max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in cells]
        objects.append((color, bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1, shape))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    y = x = 0
    prev_h = prev_w = None
    for color, oh, ow, shape in objects:
        if prev_h is not None:
            y += prev_h - 1
            x += prev_w - 1
        for dy, dx in shape:
            if 0 <= y + dy < h and 0 <= x + dx < w:
                out[y + dy][x + dx] = color
        prev_h, prev_w = oh, ow
    return out
'''
